message: Ghidra did not finish importing and analyzing the target within its 330000 ms startup deadline (REA_GHIDRA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS).

remediation.action: Large binaries can need longer: set REA_GHIDRA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS above 330000 in the environment that starts REA, or skip expensive analyzers with REA_GHIDRA_DISABLED_ANALYZERS, then open the target again. An MCP client's own tool-call timeout is separate and may also need raising.
